blocking_gaps.gap: No cross-framework final blind corpus has been evaluated once with a single frozen EffectV7.x analyzer.
blocking_gaps.exit_criterion: One preregistered run with zero known-unsafe false accepts, safe recall >= 0.80, reason accuracy >= 0.90, and classified coverage >= 0.90.

blocking_gaps.gap: H8C calibrates a five-workload CV/audio cache suite with full pilot oracle benefit and zero hybrid violations, but the corpus is synthetic/internal and its oracle is not independent.
blocking_gaps.exit_criterion: Run the same schema on an independently sealed, real, unseen corpus and achieve >= 0.90 of human-oracle performance benefit with zero semantic violations.

blocking_gaps.gap: The final oracle and adapter-effort measurements lack independent human review.
blocking_gaps.exit_criterion: A second annotator or supervisor audits all unsafe cases and a random safe subset; disagreements are adjudicated before unsealing predictions.

blocking_gaps.gap: Existing ablations predate EffectV7 and do not use the final corpus and optimizer interface.
blocking_gaps.exit_criterion: Run static-only, dynamic-only, registry-only, hybrid, manual-hint, fail-closed, and human-oracle baselines under one metric schema.

recommended_sequence: implement the common benchmark runner and oracle schema
prepare a label-free public manifest and private oracle commitment
obtain independent annotation and seal a real unseen workload corpus
preregister and run the final blind benchmark
run ablation and end-to-end performance evaluation
